snippet.title: My game has been launched on Steam！我的游戏上架Steam咯！
snippet.description:
After many days of hard work, I have finally achieved a small goal in my life. My personal indie game has been launched on Steam! 🎮
If you like the look of it, I hope you can support my debut work. Please add it to your wishlist first. Thank you so much! 💖
The game is called "Jushi Island", and you can also find it by searching for "Rock Island". You can also click on the link below and it will take you directly there. Come and check it out!
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
奋战多日，终于达成人生的小目标，我的个人独立游戏也上架Steam咯🎮。
如果大家看着喜欢，希望能支持我的首部作品，先加个愿望单吧，感谢💖！
游戏名叫做《巨石岛》，搜索《Rock Island》也能找到，还可以复制点击下方链接可前往，快来围观吧～
